title: Red Hat container certification checks (preflight) on the public image
measures: Runs Red Hat's openshift-preflight `check container` against the published ygg-pg image, pulled by digest with no registry credential. Reported: checks passed, failed and errored. Passing preflight is a prerequisite for container certification; it is not the certification.
caveats: A pass says the image meets the automated checks; it says nothing about the extensions' behaviour.
